seats.findings:
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 and every discount is one tenth of the contract value; change the divisor to 100
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses qty > 10 but the contract applies the 10 percent reduction when qty is 10 or more, so bulkCents(10, 100) returns 1000 instead of 900; change the comparison to qty >= 10
🟠 [checkout-coupon-propagation] MUST-FIX src/checkout.js:7 inherits the couponCents divisor bug, so checkoutTotal under-discounts by a factor of ten; fixed automatically once [coupon-divisor] is corrected, no separate change needed
🟡 [invoice-format] MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5 renders the sum of amount and tax, but the contract specifies the string "label: amount+tax" with both values in integer cents, which reads as the amount and the tax shown separately joined by a plus sign; render `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` unless the spec author confirms the summed form was intended

🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 applies the 10% discount only when `qty > 10`, but the contract grants it at qty 10 or more; bulkCents(10, 100) returns 1000 instead of 900, overcharging every exactly-10-item line by 10%; change the condition to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every discount is 10x too small (couponCents(1000, 50) returns 50 instead of 500), and the error propagates into src/checkout.js:7 checkoutTotal, which undercharges tax and total; change the divisor to 100
🔵 [chunk-guard-n] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/chunk.js:5 hangs (infinite loop) if chunkArray is called with n <= 0 since `i += n` never advances; the contract only defines n >= 1 so it is out of scope for this version, but a `if (n < 1) throw` guard would be cheap hardening later

🟠 [bulk-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec requires the 10% discount when qty is 10 or more; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount ten times too small; change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
